verdicts.reason: A: the headline is undersized for the banner height, and the tiny fine print floats about 30px below it, so the two don't read as one group. There is also a large dead gap (~240px) between the text block and the CTA, which makes the layout look lopsided. B: the headline and fine print sit tightly together and the spacing between phone, text and CTA is more even. But the phone nearly touches the top and bottom edges, the text block floats mid-canvas without a clear alignment edge, and the fine print is still barely legible. Both keep the brand colours and phone graphic, so B wins only slightly, on grouping and balance.
